328:      "kind": "design_choice",
329:      "text": "组织模型采用“单层归类 + 可选标签”，并设一个默认收件箱（未分类）承接未整理保存；理由是场景用的是“归类/移动到归类/默认归类”的说法，而上游只有标签，且强制保存时立即建标签，无法表达“先放着，稍后再归档”。"
330:     },
331:     {
332:      "id": "dc-02",
333:      "kind": "design_choice",
334:      "text": "保存成本压到最低：仅 URL 必填；标题在可获取时自动带入，否则由 hostname 兜底并允许用户改写；描述、标签、归类均非必填。明确不复制上游“描述必填 + 至少 1 个标签”的门槛，因为那与“看到就存、以后再处理”的场景冲突。"

338:      "kind": "design_choice",
339:      "text": "持久化采用单用户本地优先存储（IndexedDB），不引入账号体系；本试点明确不承诺跨设备/跨浏览器同步，并把这一点写成显式产品限制，而不是留作隐含缺口。上游同样是本地存储，但其 README 的“浏览器本地”并未宣称多端。"

344:      "text": "“回到原页面”是主操作：记录卡片提供直接可见的打开动作（整卡或主按钮），在新标签页以 noopener,noreferrer 打开 URL，并记录最近打开时间；不采用上游把 Visit 藏在溢出菜单里的做法。打开后应用仍停留在库视图，不接管内容消费。"

643:     "README.md": "# Bookmark Manager\n\nA fast, modern, and privacy-focused bookmark manager built for the web. Organize, tag, and manage your links with a clean and responsive interface. All data is stored locally in your browser using IndexedDB, ensuring complete privacy and offline access.\n\nThis project is based on the [Bookmark Manager App challenge by Frontend Mentor](https://www.frontendmentor.io/challenges/bookmark-manager-app).\n\n## Preview\n\n![Homepage Preview](./preview.png)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Local-First Storage**\n  All bookmarks are stored securely in your browser using IndexedDB. No accounts, servers, or tracking.\n\n- **Tagging System**\n  Organize bookmarks with custom tags for quick filtering and discovery.\n\n- **Smart Sorting**\n  Sort bookmarks by recently added, recently visited, or most visited.\n\n- **Archiving & Pinning**\n  Archive old bookmarks to reduce clutter or pin important links to the top.\n\n- **Responsive Design**\n  Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.\n\n- **Dark Mode**\n  Clean high-contrast dark theme powered by DaisyUI.\n\n- **Fast & Reactive UI**\n  Built with Ripple TS for minimal overhead and smooth interactions.\n\n## Tech Stack\n\nBuilt using modern web technologies:\n\n- **Framework:** Ripple TS\n- **Build Tool:** Vite\n- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4 + DaisyUI v5\n- **Database:** Dexie.js (IndexedDB wrapper)\n- **Validation:** Valibot\n- **Package Manager:** Bun\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\nEnsure you have [Bun](https://bun.sh) installed on your system.\n\n### Installation\n\n1.
